Start date: 1817-01-19  
Add 30 weeks = 210 days  
Add 6 days = total 216 days  

1817 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Days from Jan 19 to end of Jan: 12 days (Jan has 31 days)  
Remaining days after Jan: 216 - 12 = 204 days  

Feb (28 days) → 204 - 28 = 176  
Mar (31) → 176 - 31 = 145  
Apr (30) → 145 - 30 = 115  
May (31) → 115 - 31 = 84  
Jun (30) → 84 - 30 = 54  
Jul (31) → 54 - 31 = 23  
Aug (31) → 23 - 31 → goes negative, so stop at July.  

After July 31, remaining 23 days → August 23, 1817.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1817-08-23
